#### checklist-buying-offers-payout-failure-reasons-survive-retries

- Test Run 1 Result: BLOCKED
- Case: A payout that failed twice shows BOTH reasons, not just the last
- Batch: `buying/offers--admin--p1` · Page: `/admin/payouts`
- Classification: Blocker
- Detail: Not reached, and it needs a specific fixture I did not confirm exists — a payout that has failed MORE THAN ONCE. Recording the method note that matters: this case is a snapshot-diff detector, and the way it fails is subtle. If the history is built by diffing the current record against a single earlier snapshot rather than appending per transition, only the most recent reason survives and the page still looks perfectly reasonable — there is no error, just one entry where there should be several. So the count of entries against the number of attempts (step 6) is the assertion that actually catch
- Evidence: not attempted; requires a twice-failed payout fixture, unconfirmed
- Screenshot: `tester/.tester-runs/run-1789432098900/shots/admin-sections-no-create-no-row-affordance.png`
- Expected: Batch payout writes thread a RUNNING copy of the record rather than the original snapshot. Diffing the last write against the first snapshot loses everything in between — a pending, processing, failed sequence would record only the final state and the dispatch attempt would vanish.
